RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel does not prove deliberate discrimination, but it heightens the risk of unconscious affinity bias. Crucially, many civil services mandate gender-balanced interview panels. If your ministry has such a guideline, the panel’s composition alone may constitute a procedural irregularity worth challenging.

However, avoid alleging bias prematurely. First, send a firm follow-up requesting your written feedback, interview notes, and scoring rubrics. Review whether the successful candidate’s international experience legitimately matched specific role criteria that outweighed your civil service tenure. Once you have the written rationale and have checked your civil service commission's recruitment code on panel composition, you can determine whether to raise a procedural inquiry or formal grievance.
